method.guide_scope: All Markdown except audits/, coverage, expansion-audit, coverage-audit, table-of-contents and source-index.
method.source_scope: Files returned by rg --files, excluding docs-ai; includes tests, bundled headers and conditional code.
method.interpretation: A citation identifies a file, not reviewed lines or explained behavior. No citation is a search lead, not proof that a mechanism is absent from the guides.
method.lines: Physical lines including comments and blank lines.
